semantic-entity publishes a registry and reports PUBLISHED while the owner's declared contract is absent; reloading then raises FileNotFoundError naming the missing schema, so the owner cannot read back what it wrote.

learned: R01 dependency review complete for all 12 records. Porting the 10 absent owners would add unreachable modules to honour contracts nothing consumes in this checkout; the contracts/owners belong to a different product surface than the bootstrap runtime, so copying is the wrong default. Fix is a source repair that reproduces the defect first, not a contract copy.
